work.title: Selected work
work.subtitle: Client projects and a personal tool, 2023–2026.

eyewear.title: Eyewear web performance
eyewear.description: Web performance for the online stores of a global eyewear brand. Audits combine WebPageTest, Grafana, Contentsquare and Core Web Vitals field data, and each problem found reaches the development teams as a prioritised fix with a planned release. Core Web Vitals on the sites pass Google's thresholds, and the fixes still open follow a release plan handed over to the application maintenance team.

ai.title: AI-assisted performance reports
ai.description: Performance-report is a Python tool that audits the web performance of any site and explains the results in a PDF report. Headless Chromium measures Core Web Vitals across device and network profiles, and real-user data from Grafana is added to the lab results. An LLM grounded in a curated performance knowledge base writes the analysis, in a report whose structure stays the same from run to run. The tool came out of the eyewear work and was built by AI coding agents from written specs, with tests running on GitHub Actions.

fashion.title: Luxury fashion e-commerce
fashion.description: Front-end development for the websites and online stores of two Italian luxury fashion brands. New site sections were built on a shared component library in Storybook, with their data read from GraphQL APIs.

appliances.title: Home-appliance e-commerce
appliances.description: Faster page loads for the online store of a home-appliance brand, using the Speculation Rules API to prefetch and prerender the page a shopper is likely to open next. The product listing and product detail pages were rebuilt, with A/B-test components tracked in Google Analytics. On a second appliance brand's store, the front end was developed together with teams in Germany and Spain.

ticketing.title: Event ticketing platform
ticketing.description: An event ticketing platform built full stack, from design to release. Visitors browse events and buy tickets on the public site, which connects to a secure payment gateway, and the back end and back office behind it manage the events and sales.

stack.title: Stack
stack.subtitle: Tools used day to day, in client work and personal projects.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.description: Front ends are written in TypeScript with React and Next.js, with application state in Redux or TanStack. Interfaces are built from reusable components documented in Storybook, styled with Tailwind CSS or SCSS, or with libraries such as MUI, shadcn and Radix.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Server code is written for Node.js with NestJS or Express, as REST APIs or as microservices that connect to external services. Services are packaged with Docker, run on Linux and are monitored in Grafana.

data.title: Data & APIs
data.description: APIs are built as REST, and GraphQL APIs are integrated into front ends. Data is stored in SQL databases, SQLite or MongoDB, and modelled through Prisma or TypeORM.

performance.title: Web performance
performance.description: Web performance has been the main focus since July 2026, from lab audits in Chrome DevTools and WebPageTest to real-user data in mPulse, Grafana and Contentsquare. Findings become prioritised fixes and performance budgets for new features.

ways.title: Ways of working
ways.description: Client work runs in international Agile teams, planned in Jira and Confluence from Figma designs. Personal projects are coded by AI agents such as Claude from written specs, versioned in Git and tested on GitHub Actions.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: A detailed career history (<ja>職務経歴書</ja>) is in the documents below.
experience.intro: Web development since 2023, after retraining in software through two accredited programs in Turin. The first projects were public portals and back ends. E-commerce front ends for international brands followed in 2025, and web performance became the focus in July 2026.

performance.title: Web Performance Analyst
bullets: Monitoring and auditing the websites of an international eyewear brand with WebPageTest, Grafana, Contentsquare and Core Web Vitals field data. Findings go to the development teams as prioritised tickets.
Performance requirements are set when a new feature is planned. Recurring performance meetings with the development teams and the client, and direct contact with Google on Core Web Vitals.
Agent skills for AI coding agents, with rules and review checklists for Next.js, accessibility, semantic HTML, CSS, GEO and web performance. Agents use them when they write or review code.

frontend.title: Frontend Engineer
bullets: Front-end features and GraphQL integration for two luxury fashion brands, including new site sections and a shared component library in Storybook.
Faster page loads on a home appliance e-commerce site with the Speculation Rules API, along with rebuilt product listing and product detail pages and A/B test components.
Front-end development of another e-commerce site, with Reply teams in Germany and Spain.

synesthesia.title: Web Engineer
bullets: An event ticketing portal built full stack, from the back office to the public site, with a payment gateway.
A city information platform for an Italian regional capital, with local news, events and public services.
Microservices for cart, sales and discount coupons, connected to external XML services and monitored in Grafana. Also the back end of a reservations system for rest-area management.
